blocks.text: Cell mein sab se zyada paye jane wale organic compounds proteins hain. Unhen amino acids ke polymers ke taur par bayan kiya ja sakta hai aur yeh cells ke bunyadi (principal) compounds samjhe jate hain. J. J. Berzelius ne is group ke macromolecules ki ahmiyat (importance) par zor dene ke liye lafz "protein" (Greek proteios, pehle darje ke molecules) banaya. Proteins cells aur jandaron (organisms) ki banawat (structures) ke liye aham hain aur un ke har kaam mein shareek hain; yun yeh zindagi ke building blocks ka kaam karte hain.

blocks.title: Tanawwo (diversity)
blocks.text: Hayatiyati (biological) duniya ki tanawwo proteins mein maujood banawat aur kaam ki tanawwo ka aks hai.
Proteins ki banawat

Proteins woh polymers hain jo amino acids naami monomers ke aapas mein jurne se bante hain. Mukhtalif proteins mein chand se le kar 3000 tak amino acids ho sakte hain: insulin mein 51 amino acids hain, haemoglobin mein 574.
Amino acid

Amino acid proteins ki bunyadi banawati ikai (structural unit) hai. Yeh ek organic molecule hai jis mein chaar groups, ek amino group (NH2), ek carboxyl group (COOH), ek hydrogen (H) aur ek side group (R), ek hi carbon atom, alpha carbon, se jure hain. Agarche qudrat mein bohat se mukhtalif amino acids hain, jandaron (cells aur tissues) mein taqreeban 170 qismein report hui hain; in mein se taqreeban 25 proteins ki tameeri ikaiyon ke taur par hissa le sakte hain, aur zyada tar proteins 20 qismon se bane hain. Har amino acid ki pehchan aur munfarid kemiyai khususiyat us ke side group (R) ki fitrat se tay hoti hai, jo alpha carbon se covalently jura hai: R hydrogen atom ho sakta hai, jaise glycine mein, ya CH3, jaise alanine mein, ya koi aur group.

blocks.title: Lazmi (essential) aur ghair-lazmi amino acids
blocks.text: 20 amino acids mein se hamara jism gyarah bana sakta hai, yeh ghair-lazmi amino acids hain: alanine, arginine, asparagine, aspartic acid, cysteine, glutamic acid, glutamine, glycine, proline, serine aur tyrosine. Baqi nau hamara jism khud nahin bana sakta aur unhen khuraak se lena parta hai; yeh lazmi amino acids methionine, valine, tryptophan, isoleucine, leucine, lysine, threonine, phenylalanine aur histidine (sirf bachchon ke liye zaroori) hain.
Peptide bond

Do amino acids ko jorne wala covalent bond peptide bond hai. Har amino acid ke ek sire par amino group aur doosre par carboxyl group hota hai. Jab do amino acids qareeb laye jate hain to ek ke amino group aur doosre ke carboxyl group ke darmiyan dehydration synthesis hoti hai, jis se pani ka ek molecule nikalta hai aur saath wale amino acids ke N aur C ke darmiyan peptide bond banta hai. Peptide bond se jure amino acids peptides hain; do amino acids se dipeptide banta hai, maslan glycine aur alanine se glycylalanine. Dipeptide ke ab bhi ek sire par amino group aur doosre par carboxyl group hai, is liye dono reactive hisse mazeed peptide bonds ke liye dastiyab hain, aur amino acids shamil hote rehne se aakhir polypeptide zanjeerein banti hain.

blocks.alt: Insulin motiyon ki do zanjeeron ki shakal mein: oopar naranji A chain 21 amino acids ki aur neeche hari B chain 30 ki, jis ka sira mud kar wapas aata hai. Gehre moti cysteines hain. Dashed S-S pul A7 ko B7 se aur A20 ko B19 se jorte hain, aur teesra A chain ke andar A6 ko A11 se. Key kehti hai cysteine ke -SH groups jor bana kar yeh disulphide pul banate hain.
blocks.caption: Insulin ki A aur B zanjeerein S-S bonds se juri hui (Figure 4.27 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Baen: ek kala alpha carbon jis se chaar rangdar groups jure hain, amino group, carboxyl group, hydrogen aur side group R. Daen: glycine aur alanine saath-saath, ek ka OH aur doosre ka H box mein; dehydration synthesis ka teer dipeptide glycylalanine tak jata hai jis ka naya C-N peptide bond narangi box mein hai.
blocks.caption: Amino acid ki aam banawat aur glycine aur alanine ke darmiyan peptide bond ka banna (Figures 4.23 se 4.26 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Amino acid mein amino group, carboxyl group, hydrogen aur side group R sab alpha carbon se jure hain; R tay karta hai ke yeh kaun sa amino acid hai (glycine mein H, alanine mein CH3). Dehydration synthesis mein ek amino acid ka carboxyl group OH khota hai aur agle ka amino group H; yeh pani ban kar nikalte hain aur C-N peptide bond banta hai. Dipeptide ke paas azaad amino sira aur azaad carboxyl sira rehta hai, is liye mazeed amino acids shamil ho kar polypeptide bana sakte hain. Hydrolysis pani wapas shamil kar ke bond torti hai.

blocks.text: Protein ek ya zyada polypeptide zanjeeron par mushtamil hai: insulin mein do polypeptide zanjeerein hain, haemoglobin mein chaar. Polypeptide zanjeerein apne amino acids ki tadaad, qismon aur tarteeb (sequence) ki bunyad par mukhtalif shaklein ikhtiyar karti hain, jo proteins ko banawat ki mukhtalif satahein (levels) deta hai.
Proteins ki banawat ki satahein

Proteins ki tanawwo saada proteins, jo amino acids ki seedhi zanjeeron par mushtamil hain, se le kar pecheeda (complex) proteins, jin mein seedhi zanjeeron mein banawati tabdeeliyan hain, tak phaili hai. Proteins darj-e-zail satahon par bante hain.
Primary structure

Protein ki primary structure amino acids ki seedhi tarteeb se banti hai: yeh polypeptide zanjeer mein amino acids ki tadaad aur tarteeb (sequence) dikhati hai. Tamam protein molecules, saada ya pecheeda, makhsoos primary structures rakhte hain. Insulin ki primary structure do polypeptide zanjeerein dikhati hai, chhoti alpha zanjeer 21 amino acids ki aur lambi beta zanjeer 30 ki. Isi tarah haemoglobin ki primary structure chaar polypeptide zanjeerein dikhati hai: do alpha zanjeerein har ek 141 amino acids ki aur do beta zanjeerein har ek 146 ki.

blocks.title: 10,000 se zyada proteins
blocks.text: Insani jism mein 10,000 se zyada proteins hain, aur har ek ki apni makhsoos primary structure hai: makhsoos tadaad, tarteeb aur amino acids ki qismein.

blocks.alt: (a) Collagen, fibrous protein: teen rangeen polypeptide zanjeerein aik doosre ke gird triple helix mein lipti, jo tendons, jild aur cartilage mein lambe, mazboot, na-hal hone wale resha banati hain. (b) Haemoglobin, globular protein: chaar zanjeerein, do alpha aur do beta, aik gathi hui gend mein, har aik mein iron (Fe) wala surkh haem group jo oxygen le jata hai.
blocks.caption: (a) Collagen, resha-dar (fibrous) protein; (b) haemoglobin, golai-numa (globular) protein (Figure 4.30 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Nau cards, har aik par saada khaaka: tubulin (cell ki shakal aur naql o haml ke liye microtubules), channel proteins (cheezon ko plasma membrane paar karwana), gene se judta repressor protein, khoon ke thakke mein surkh cells ko phansate fibrin ke dhaage, muscle mein oxygen jama karta myoglobin, surkh khooni cells mein oxygen le jata haemoglobin, doodh ka casein, baalon aur nakhunon ka keratin, aur muscle sikorne ke liye phisalte actin aur myosin.
blocks.caption: Insani jism ke mukhtalif proteins (Figure 4.31 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Protein ki primary structure mein amino acids ki tadaad, tarteeb aur qismein us ke theek kaam ke liye nihayat makhsoos hain. Yeh makhsoos-pan DNA mein nucleotides ki tarteeb se tay hota hai. Koi bhi tabdeeli ghair-mamooli protein banati hai jo apna aam kaam nahin kar pata. Maslan sickle cell haemoglobin har beta zanjeer mein jagah chhe par sirf ek amino acid ki tarteeb ki ghalati se banta hai, jahan glutamic acid ki jagah valine hota hai. Sickle cell haemoglobin ki wajah se red blood cells darati (sickle) jaisi shakal le lete hain aur ghair-mamooli haemoglobin kafi oxygen nahin le ja sakta. Yeh beemari sickle cell anaemia hai.
Secondary structure

Bohat se proteins mein polypeptide zanjeer ke andar folding ya coiling ke namoone bante hain; yeh secondary structure hai. Polypeptide zanjeer ka kundli (coil) banna alpha helix deta hai, jabke folding pleated sheet banati hai. Dono banawat zanjeer ke qareebi amino acids ke amino aur carboxyl groups ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds se qaim rehti hain.
Tertiary structure

Jab secondary structure mazeed fold ho kar pecheeda globular shakal le leti hai to yeh tertiary structure hai; yeh zyada pecheeda proteins hain. Globular shakal ionic, hydrogen aur disulphide bonds se qaim rehti hai, jo protein ke majmui istehkam (stability) aur shakal mein hissa dalte hain. Polypeptide zanjeer ke amino acids pani se taalluq kar ke sab se mustahkam tertiary structure, globular shakal, hydrophilic aur hydrophobic taalluqat ke zariye banate hain: hydrophobic (non-polar) amino acids is tarah ikatthe hote hain ke pani ke molecules ki hydrogen bonding ko torte hain aur yun andar dafan ho jate hain, jabke hydrophilic (polar) amino acids bahar, pani ki satah ki taraf mur jate hain.
Quaternary structure

Jab tertiary structures wali do ya zyada polypeptide zanjeerein hydrophobic taalluqat, hydrogen bonds aur ionic bonds se saath juri hon to sab se pecheeda proteins bante hain. Tertiary structures ka yeh ijtima protein ki quaternary structure hai.

blocks.alt: Baen se daen chaar marhale: primary structure ke liye motiyon ki zanjeer; secondary ke liye alpha helix aur zigzag pleated sheet; tertiary ke liye nuqtedar cross-links wali fold-shuda globular zanjeer; aur quaternary ke liye saath packed chaar fold-shuda zanjeerein, do jamni aur do neeli. Neeche do amino acid sequences haemoglobin ki normal beta zanjeer, jagah 6 par glutamic acid, aur sickle zanjeer, wahan valine, ka muqabla karte hain.
blocks.caption: Protein ki banawat ki chaar satahein, aur sickle cell haemoglobin mein ek tabdeeli (Figures 4.27 se 4.29 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Primary structure peptide bonds se jure amino acids ki seedhi tarteeb hai, jo DNA tay karta hai; insulin mein 21 ki alpha aur 30 ki beta zanjeer hai. Secondary structure alpha helix mein coiling ya pleated sheet mein folding hai, jo amino aur carboxyl groups ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds se qaim hai. Tertiary structure mazeed folding se globular shakal hai jo ionic, hydrogen aur disulphide bonds se qaim hai, hydrophobic side groups andar aur hydrophilic pani ki taraf. Quaternary structure do ya zyada fold-shuda zanjeeron ka saath hona hai, jaise haemoglobin ki 141 ki do alpha aur 146 amino acids ki do beta zanjeerein. Sickle cell haemoglobin mein har beta zanjeer ki jagah 6 par glutamic acid ki jagah valine hai, red cells darati jaise ho jate hain aur bohat kam oxygen le jate hain.

blocks.text: Proteins ki darja-bandi (classification)

Proteins bohat mutanawwe group hain aur mukhtalif bunyadon par darja-band kiye ja sakte hain. Jandaron mein apne kirdar ki bunyad par yeh structural proteins aur functional proteins hain. Tajweez-karda darja-bandi banawat par mabni hai, fibrous proteins aur globular proteins ke taur par.

blocks.text: Zindagi mein proteins ka kirdar
Proteins jandaron ki taqreeban tamam sargarmiyan anjam dete hain. Un ke kuch qabil-e-zikr banawati aur kaam ke kirdar yeh hain.

items: Proteins tamam plasma membranes ki tarkeeb ka aham hissa hain. Cell membranes ke channel proteins cells ke andar-bahar maddon ki harkat qaboo karte hain; maslan proteins neurons ki cell membrane mein sodium-potassium pump banate hain, jo nerve cell ke andar-bahar Na+ aur K+ ions ki harkat qaboo karta hai.
Kuch fibrous proteins, maslan collagen aur keratin, bil-tarteeb cartilage aur baal, nakhun ki taqreeban poori banawat banate hain.
Enzymes proteins ki woh class hain jo cells ke metabolism ko tez (catalyse) karte hain, bohat mutanawwe class: proteases proteins ka tootna tez karte hain, polymerases polymers ka banna.

Janwaron ke kuch bohat aham hormones protein ya peptide hain: insulin (khoon mein glucose ki satah qaboo karta hai), antidiuretic hormone (gurdon mein pani rokna barhata hai) aur oxytocin (doodh ki paidawar qaboo karta hai).

Kuch globular proteins jism mein maddey le jate hain: haemoglobin aur myoglobin oxygen aur kuch carbon dioxide le jate hain, aur cytochromes electron transport chain mein electron carriers ka kaam karte hain.
Albumin khoon ka protein hai jo khoon ki osmotic concentration qaim rakhta hai aur us ki behne ki salahiyat barqarar rakhta hai.

Khoon ka jamna chot ke baad khoon ke zaya hone se bachata hai. Protein fibrinogen khoon mein maujood hai; chot lagne par yeh fibrin mein faal ho jata hai, jo reshe banata hai, aur lothra ban jata hai.
Zinda madde mein tamam sukarne (contractions) proteins ki wajah se hain: actin aur myosin, muscles ke bunyadi proteins, muscle ke sukarne ke zimmedar hain, aur tubulin spindle fibres banata hai.
Antibodies ajnabi (foreign) maddon (antigens) ko pehchan kar un se jurti hain aur unhen be-zarar banati hain.

Kuch ion-binding proteins jism ke mukhtalif hisson mein ions zakheera karte hain: ferritin cell ke andar lohe (iron) ka bunyadi zakheera protein hai, aur casein, doodh ka protein, potassium aur calcium ions zakheera karta hai.
Repressors woh proteins hain jo RNA ki tayyari rok kar gene ke kaam ko qaboo karte hain, taake genes wahan aur tab kaam karen jahan aur jab zaroorat ho.

blocks.title: Ferritin bataur test
blocks.text: Mareezon mein khoon ki ferritin satah anaemia ki tashkhees (diagnosis) ke aale ke taur par napi jati hai. Agar ferritin zyada hai to loha zyada hai; agar kam hai to lohe ki kami ka khatra hai, jo jald ya ba-deer anaemia ka sabab ban sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Haemoglobin ki beta zanjeer ke 146 mein se ek ghalat amino acid sickle cell anaemia paida karta hai. Protein ki banawat ki satahon se samjhayen ke itni chhoti tabdeeli itni aham kyun ho sakti hai.
blocks.explanation: Primary sequence tay karti hai ke zanjeer kaise coil aur fold hogi: side groups tay karte hain ke kaun se hisse hydrophobic ya hydrophilic hain aur kaun se bonds ban sakte hain. Jagah 6 par polar glutamic acid ki jagah non-polar valine fold-shuda zanjeer ki satah badal deta hai, is liye haemoglobin molecules aapas mein chipak jate hain, red cell ko darati mein bigaar dete hain aur oxygen kam le jate hain. Kaam teen-jehti (three-dimensional) shakal par munhasir hai, aur shakal sequence par.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Proteins amino acids ke polymers hain, cell ke sab se zyada paye jane wale organic compounds (Berzelius: proteios, pehla darja). Amino acid mein alpha carbon par NH2, COOH, H aur R hain; R pehchan deta hai. Taqreeban 20 zyada tar proteins banate hain: 11 ghair-lazmi, 9 lazmi khuraak se.

Peptide bonds ek amino acid ke amino group aur agle ke carboxyl ke darmiyan dehydration synthesis se bante hain; dipeptides polypeptides mein barhte hain. Insulin mein 2 zanjeerein (21 aur 30), haemoglobin mein 4 (141, 141, 146, 146).

Satahein: primary (sequence, DNA se tay; sickle cell: jagah 6 par glutamic acid ki jagah valine), secondary (alpha helix, pleated sheet; hydrogen bonds), tertiary (globular; ionic, hydrogen, disulphide bonds; hydrophobic andar), quaternary (kai fold-shuda zanjeerein).

Fibrous proteins structural, na-hal-hone wale, primary ya secondary hain (silk, keratin, collagen, fibrin, actin); globular proteins functional, hal hone wale, tertiary ya quaternary hain (enzymes, antibodies, hormones, haemoglobin).

Kirdar: membranes aur pumps, banawat, enzymes, hormones, transport, albumin, khoon ka jamna (fibrinogen se fibrin), sukarna (actin, myosin, tubulin), antibodies, ion zakheera (ferritin, casein), repressors.
